task: Reconstruct this raw human brain MRI, compare two retrospective sampling settings, and show what supports the result.
status: Completed illustrative comparison with qualified findings; accelerated reconstructions are not asserted to meet a quality threshold

source.selection: First validation T2 repetition-1 acquisition in author manifest; fixed slice index 8 before reconstruction

input.native_axes: slice,coil,FE,PE per official H5_FORMAT.md; legacy XML custom PE/FE labels conflict
input.orientation: Native source axial view retained; no anatomical side labels inferred without voxel-to-patient direction matrix
input.preexisting_processing: Provider applied k-space phase modulation for global image off-centering; no new motion correction

parameters.retrospective_sampling: Available source PE lines intersected with even/every-fourth global PE indices, plus retained central 24 lines (116:140)
parameters.fixed_parameters: Original ESPIRiT map parameters retained. One fixed skill-example L1 weight .01 applied identically to both masks; no reference-driven per-mask parameter tuning. Additional400iterations assess convergence, not quality tuning.

checks.ROI_description: Post-hoc diagnostic after reviewing the first SENSE results: DIPY median_otsu of source RSS (radius3,two passes), hole fill and2pixelerosion; same ROI for all methods. Not a prespecified endpoint or independently validated brain segmentation; full-FOV metrics remain primary descriptive results.
checks.calibration_exploration: source/calibration-diagnostic.json; larger SVD thresholds/widths did not justify a change to original parameters

display.common_normalization: All k-space/reference/recon arrays divided by source RSS maximum; no intensity matching fitted to each result

metric_definitions.measured_data_residual: L2(P F S recon - P k)/L2(P k)
metric_definitions.heldout_source_data_residual: L2(Q F S recon - Q k)/L2(Q k) on source lines removed retrospectively; Q not provided to the inverse solve
metric_definitions.source_rss_reference: Centered inverse FFT and RSS of all available195source lines; not noise-free or complete-PE ground truth

limitations: One selected acquired human slice and four-channel low-field system; no cross-subject or clinical generalization
Retrospective masks are not new scanner acquisitions; efficiency relative to available source195PElines
Published source is already missing61storedPEcolumns; all-source RSS is a noisy reference, not anatomical ground truth
No coil-noise covariance/prewhitening, g-factor or pseudo-replica SNR estimation; acceleration-related noise cost not quantified
Residuals and iteration behavior do not establish anatomical truth
No independent patient-space orientation matrix; retain native source view without invented L/R labels
No with/without-MRFoundry control, task-success rate, speedup, or memory-benefit claim
Source-reference error and data residual include low-field noise, coil-model mismatch and regularization; root cause is not isolated by this single case
initial_solver_diagnostic: initial-sense-report.json; initial weakly L2-regularized SENSE outputs retained, not presented as validated success
interpretation: The higher retrospective acceleration has larger source-reference discrepancy for this fixed solver and slice. Full-FOV metrics include substantial low-field background noise and RSS bias; image-intensity-ROI metrics are post-hoc descriptive sensitivity analyses. The L1 reconstructions have larger full-FOV RSS discrepancy than zero-filled RSS baselines, so no reconstruction improvement is claimed. Measured/heldout residuals are not anatomical truth. No clinical, prospective acquisition or agent-superiority conclusion.
